description: Centrifuge Modeling of Hydrodynamic Loading in Water Tanks is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Katerina Ziotopoulou, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). Many U.S. west coast cities have constructed buried water tanks for potable water supply. Earthquake activity can damage these structures, which can lead to rupture and flooding and can impede fire suppression efforts and delay economic activities. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Centrifuge, CGM, Hydrodynamics. Published 2024-05-14. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
